purpose: Quantify twilight sky-radiance and naked-eye Level-B sensitivity to independently controlled aerosol single-scattering albedo and asymmetry parameter at fixed AOD, without modifying AFC2 R8.

motivation.r8Finding: Shettle aerosol family/season choice produced real but modest Level-B threshold shifts; urban spring-summer versus rural spring-summer at AOD550=0.30 was approximately +0.11,+0.10,+0.10,+0.056 mag at 2,4,6,8 degree sun depression, with wider geometry scatter at 6-8 degrees.
motivation.nextQuestion: At fixed aerosol optical depth, how much of twilight visibility sensitivity can be produced by independent changes in aerosol absorption (SSA) and scattering anisotropy (g)?
motivation.scopeBoundary: This is a controlled optical-property sensitivity experiment. Constant SSA/g overrides across the visible spectrum are not claimed to be a realistic aerosol climatology or spectral microphysics model.

libRadtranControlSurface.nativeReference: R8 rural / spring-summer Shettle state with fixed AOD550 and no aerosol_modify ssa/gg override
libRadtranControlSurface.overrideInterpretation: The modified factorial states deliberately overwrite SSA and g profiles to isolate optical-property sensitivity.

rangeRationale.ssa: 0.85 and 0.98 are deliberately broad visible-wavelength sensitivity endpoints within published observational examples; they are not assigned probabilities.
rangeRationale.gg: 0.60 and 0.80 are deliberately broad sensitivity endpoints spanning documented visible/near-visible aerosol asymmetry examples; they are not assigned probabilities.
rangeRationale.spectralCaveat: Because set overrides are constant rather than wavelength-dependent, this screen isolates sensitivity and must not be interpreted as a realistic spectral aerosol mixture.

primaryContrasts.nativeReferenceContrasts: For each cell and replicate, log(alternative/native) for each of the four controlled factorial states.
primaryContrasts.ssaContrasts: Within each fixed g endpoint, replicate-paired log(high-SSA/low-SSA).
primaryContrasts.gContrasts: Within each fixed SSA endpoint, replicate-paired log(high-g/low-g).
primaryContrasts.interactionContrast: Replicate-wise difference-in-differences on log response: [log Y(0.98,0.80)-log Y(0.85,0.80)]-[log Y(0.98,0.60)-log Y(0.85,0.60)].
primaryContrasts.uncertainty: For every preregistered replicate-paired contrast retain all 3 values; report mean, sample SD, and SE=SD/sqrt(3). No independent-error quadrature.

secondaryLevelBEndpoint.interpretation: Paired delta is the intended user-facing visibility sensitivity. A universal minute shift is forbidden; any time conversion requires actual date/location solar-depression rate.

literatureNotes: libRadtran 2.0.6 User's Guide documents aerosol_modify ssa set and aerosol_modify gg set and describes them as overwriting aerosol optical-property profiles.
Published AERONET-based literature reports visible SSA spanning roughly the low-0.8s to high-0.9s across aerosol regimes; the selected 0.85/0.98 endpoints are a broad controlled envelope.
Published aerosol observations report substantial asymmetry-parameter variability; the selected 0.60/0.80 endpoints are a broad controlled envelope.
